name: labs/steinkohl__korad_powersupply
title: Korad KC3405P power supply (korad.KC3405P)
intro: Korad KC3405P power supply (korad.KC3405P), adapted from steinkohl/korad_powersupply. It reads `channel`, `voltage`, `current`, `regulation_mode` and 4 more; sets `voltage_setpoint`, `current_setpoint`, `overvoltage_protection_setpoint`, `overcurrent_protection_setpoint` and 3 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: send OUT1234:0 to all four outputs through the native send path (the safe state); it takes no input and does not wait for a status reply. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
